text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a day out, Tokai Teio and I return
to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, I think I finally figured it
out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know, the answer to Prez's
assignment about
what you mean to me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I'm thinking it's about time I went and
told her
what I've come up with.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ♪ Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She rushes off feeling confident. Curious
to see
how it goes, I wait by the student
council office.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer? ...Were you waiting here for
me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...She rejected my answer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I told her you're someone who praises
me when I
do good and stops me when I
get out of line. But
then...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Think carefully about what you just told
me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Praise and admonishment are not
difficult things
to come by; a maid or
butler could provide you
with the same.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh! When you put it like that...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Can that truly be the extent of your
trainer's role?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why, of all people, did you pick him to
guide you
on your path?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why, of all people, did you pick her to
guide you
on your path?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, I...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That hesitation right there is why I
cannot accept
your answer. You must try
again.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...That's the short of it. What was I
supposed to
say?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What would you say? Why did you choose me out of all the other racers?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first time I saw Tokai Teio run with
such
freedom and power, I couldn't take
my eyes off
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open up to her about how, from that
moment
on, I was captivated by her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I... I want to show you that, too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I want to get strong enough to capture
everyone's
hearts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that powerful glimmer in her
eyes, I know
there's no other racer I'd
rather train.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Well done. You two make for a
surprisingly
good combination.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: P-Prez! You heard us?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You were right outside my door. I
could hear
everything from inside.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I take back my earlier statement. The
assignment
is complete.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume and their trainers are
inextricably
linked. They both grow
through mutual respect,
trust, and
learning from one another.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hope to see great things from both of
you in the
future.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm gonna work hard... right
alongside my
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This assignment has been a valuable
experience
for both Teio and myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Teio "declared war" on Symboli
Rudolf, I
made her a promise that we
would work hard
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And when we were at the amusement
park, I made
a promise about the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Teio that whether as her trainer or
her
friend, I will always honor my
promises to her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to honor my promises to you,
too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna surpass Prez, and you'll be
there to
shower me with praise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that powerful glimmer in her
eyes, I know
there's no other racer I'd
rather train.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Well done. It seems my meddling was

uncalled-for after all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: P-Prez! You heard us?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You were right outside my door. I
could hear
everything from inside.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You know, perhaps I've been a little too
soft on
you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wha? Nooo, feel free to spoil me all you
want! ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do not try me. In any case, I'll consider
your
assignment complete.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume and their trainers are
inextricably
linked. They both grow
through mutual respect,
trust, and
learning from one another.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hope to see great things from both of
you in the
future.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm gonna work hard... right
alongside my
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This assignment has been a valuable
experience
for both Teio and myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I chose Teio because, well, she's Teio. I wanted to train her. When I tell her as much, she gasps.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because I'm... me. Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whether I'm happy because I won, or
frustrated
because I'm worried...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're always there to lend me an ear.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I've gotten to where I am today because it's been you by my side.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't want anyone else either! I just
want you!
My trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I want you to praise me and to scold
me... and to
write the legend of the
invincible Teio together
with me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're the only trainer in the whole wide
world
for me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I suppose that answer is worth a
passing
grade. The assignment is over.

text_block_list.text: P-Prez! You heard us?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

everything from inside.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm gonna work hard... right

trainer!

experience
for both Teio and myself.
